# watchpoint_threshold_profile (Data Source)

Looks up a single threshold profile by name within the tenant. Returns the scalar profile fields only; threshold rules are not included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_threshold_profile" "default" {
  name = "Default Threshold Profile"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the threshold profile to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Threshold profile ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the tenant's default threshold profile.
